slam.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent painted animation effects for Ribbon Raspberry in a 2D cartoon anime action game. Reference image shows the established pink satin ribbon material; create NEW clean action effects with stronger energy and no grey checkerboard, particles outside cells, backdrop, labels or borders.
Exactly 8 equally sized square cels in a 4-column 2-row sheet, transparent background. Each drawing separated with generous transparent margins. Color: raspberry pink satin edges, pearly cream/pink inner highlights, dark plum hand-drawn outlines, small warm yellow star highlights. Painterly cartoon animation cels, NOT vector line art, not geometric circles, not lasers. No character, wand, weapon handle or objects.
ROW ONE: four consecutive phases of ONE heavy overhead ribbon lash traveling LEFT TO RIGHT. Each frame starts at the SAME tiny tapered attachment point located 14% of cell width and 45% of cell height. Ribbon is narrow where attached, a wide twisting satin strip through the body, with a sharp taper at the end.
Frame1: anticipate: ribbon rises up in a tall smooth open arch from left attachment to upper centre-right, tip curls downward on the right.
Frame2: forceful downward whip CRACK: flattened diagonal broad satin ribbon sweeping from the attachment toward lower-right ending near 85% width 72% height, big irregular pointed cream-pink impact flare at that lower-right tip. A crisp cartoon speed smear follows the ribbon's curve.
Frame3: follow-through: S-shaped ribbon loosely returning from that same attachment toward lower right, wide fold and forked fluttering tip, smaller glowing flare dying at the right.
Frame4: recoil: thinner, shorter, loose fluttering satin ribbon from same attachment to centre-right, a few falling pink fragments. Open shapes only, never a closed ring.
ROW TWO: four animation frames of the impact ALONE, centered near bottom middle of each square. Ground contact should line up at 82% cell height. Frame1 compressed small sharp pink-white four-point star at ground with short curling gold dust; frame2 broad dynamic jagged manga impact burst, pink and cream with curling satin scraps and a few yellow sparks; frame3 fragments curl upward and outward in an uneven spray as the centre opens; frame4 fragments and soft dust settle and dissipate. This is a small magical whip-impact effect, not a giant explosion or fire. No opaque white square and no background. Keep every effect entirely inside its own cell.

spin.prompt:
Create an additional production animation sprite sheet matching the referenced Hexy EXACTLY. She is the same chibi pink-haired witch, navy hat with yellow star, white sailor blouse/red bow/navy pleated skirt, black shoes with gold buckles. Use exact head/body proportions, illustrated shading and colors from the reference. The new action is ONE COMPLETE 360-degree attack spin around her OWN VERTICAL AXIS, pivoting on her boots, not a somersault, not orbiting around something. Arms swing a short yellow star-tipped wand in a horizontal sweep. Both hands together grip the same wand in EVERY frame. One wand, two arms, two legs.
Exactly EIGHT FULL-BODY cels arranged in 4 columns x 2 rows. True transparent background. All figures share fixed scale and ground baseline within their cells, large empty gutters, every hat/boot/wand fully inside its cel. No labels, text, borders, painted ground, shadows, ribbon or baked effects. Empty transparent areas between drawings.
CRITICAL: each frame has a genuinely DIFFERENT camera-facing direction of the CHARACTER because she is ROTATING. The camera is fixed. Do NOT draw eight right-facing poses.
Frame1: facing RIGHT profile, knees bent, both hands extend star wand right, forward lean initiating pivot.
Frame2: rear three-quarter view facing back-right, back of hat and hair prominent, wand held to upper right.
Frame3: FULL BACK VIEW, back of blouse and huge flowing pink hair, back of hat, both elbows out and wand extending to left as hips turn.
Frame4: rear three-quarter view facing LEFT, weight rotating across boots, hair sweeping to right, wand left.
Frame5: clear LEFT profile, both arms extend wand left, rear heel lifted, torso forward.
Frame6: FRONT three-quarter view facing left, red sailor bow visible, twisting waist, wand low left.
Frame7: FULL FRONT VIEW facing camera, both eyes and red bow visible, two hands sweep wand across front chest toward right, hair flares sideways.
Frame8: front three-quarter view facing RIGHT, one boot completes the pivot, both hands extend wand right, lively confident focus, settles toward frame1.
Keep skirt normal and opaque, no exposed underwear. Hair and hat follow through with centrifugal motion, skirt flares modestly over legs. This must be a satisfying animated action pirouette with a readable changing silhouette, not repeated static doll poses. Exact canonical character identity.
